g.text: 1. ALL DIMENSIONS ARE IN METERS & MILLIMETERS UNLESS SPECIFIED.

3. VERIFY ALL SITE LEVELS AND BOUNDARY OFFSETS PRIOR TO COMMENCEMENT.
5. VENTILATION & DAYLIGHT COMPLIANT WITH NBC 2016 PART 3.
6. STRUCTURAL GRID & COLUMN LAYOUT SUBJECT TO CERTIFIED FEA CHECK.
